subject: homework
activityTitle: The Keeper's Workshop: Seven Stuck Clocks
learningFocus: Untaught reading of analog clock faces to the nearest five minutes: which hand is which, minute ring counted by fives, hour named as the last hour passed.
mechanic: A sequence of seven workbench clocks, one at a time. Reina taps a choice, types a number on a big-key keypad, or (for the last item) speaks/types how she figures out minutes. Every prompt has a speaker icon for read-aloud and one 'say that again' restatement. There is deliberately no right/wrong feedback: each answered clock is carried to a shelf and its lamp lights the same warm amber regardless of answer — the workshop is remembering, not judging. Item order and interaction modes follow the immutable seven-item contract exactly.
currentChallenge: Look at this clock. Which hand tells you the minutes?
progress: The Keeper's Workshop: Seven Stuck Clocks started.
